answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity with a mandatory proof-of-personhood bond. Each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation; a sybil cluster must replicate that cost across every fake identity, so faking N agents costs N times the bond. A single ripple of collusion triggers slashing, and the attacker loses the whole tundra of locked funds. Honest peers in the canyon of the ledger verify bonds before attesting.
